name: Vantg Blue
lede: Vantg Blue is a vivid, violet-leaning [[blue]] whose own name is undocumented in our sources, including what the short word "Vantg" is meant to abbreviate.

sections.title: An undocumented, unexplained name
sections.body:
Our library traces the name only to a Wikipedia color list, which gives no date and no gloss of the word Vantg [1]. It is not a standard English word, and the sources consulted do not say what, if anything, it shortens or where it came from [1].

Its closest standing colors are [[neon-blue]], 3.6 units away by CIEDE2000 and more vivid, [[azure]] at 4.4, duller, and [[royal-blue]] at 5.5, duller and darker [2]. Measured in LCH it reads lightness 53, chroma 82, one of the most saturated blues in our library [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our 23,781-painting archive has this color covering at least 1% of its canvas, within CIEDE2000 4 of it, as photographed [3]. That describes what our particular archive happened to collect, not painting as a whole; a color this bright and saturated is uncommon in older museum work generally [3].
